notes: The release that publishes the Windows toolchain of tools/windows_toolchain.json, read by its tag (tools/windows_toolchain.py).
spec_sha256 is windows_toolchain.spec_digest of the specification; archive_sha256 is the archive's digest in that release's manifest.
Change it with every specification change, once the new toolchain is published; keep its revision in packaging/pinned_cache_revisions.json so that the release is never pruned.
